snippet.title: Beau Counter Guide | RingNet Scoop | Farlight 84
snippet.description:
Chances are, many Lightcatchers—Lighty included—have been caught off guard by Beau’s “Vengeance Bomb.”
Don’t panic!
In this episode of RingNet Scoop, Lighty breaks down how different heroes can counter Beau’s ult in real combat—helping you stay cool and fight back in the summer update!

ABOUT FARLIGHT 84

In Farlight 84, you get to play as heroes with unique skills to outsmart your enemies, unleashing special abilities to catch them off guard... AND you get to collect adorable Buddies to join you as loyal companions in battle. Buddy up, it’s time to Battle Royale!
